name: Namari no Konbou
source:
About 38 hours passed.

The child was kidnapped from her home. In the basement of a deserted clinic, nestled deep in the mountains and shrouded in total darkness, she endured ongoing sexual abuse. 
Despite succumbing to insanity due to the unimaginable agony, and ultimately dying, the torment did not cease.
Her body was discovered cast into the sea about 38 hours later, brutally skinned alive like a pig, her fingertips charred.

What in the world have you done?

[Translated from [url=https://unclesheepclub.web.fc2.com/letters/namari/namari.html]official website[/url]]
